correctness.rationale: Independently reconstructed a once-subdivided K3,3 with 15 vertices,18 edges and the unordered three-particle cubical complex with chain ranks (455,1404,1386,432); rebuilt every signed cubical differential and verified ∂²=0. Independently sparse-eliminated ranks 454 mod2 for ∂1, 946 mod3 for ∂2, 432 mod2 for ∂3. These yield only rational lower bounds; the augmentation bound on ∂1, full-domain bound on ∂3 and four independent square total-motion cycles of the original graph with two parked particles give rational upper bounds, forcing exact ranks and Betti (1,4,8,0). Independently enumerated all 72 oriented cubical symmetry actions: χ2(p,q,0)=v(p)v(q)+sgn(p)v(q)+v(p)sgn(q), χ2(p,q,1)=-v(pq), v(p)=fix(p)-1; nine conjugacy class sizes/traces (1,8),(6,-2),(4,-1),(9,0),(12,1),(4,-1),(6,-2),(18,0),(12,1). Standard S3≀C2 character inner products give irreducible 4D V_- plus induced 4D sign⊠V with no full-group invariants. Abrams sufficient-subdivision hypotheses hold (essential graph distances 2, essential loops length≥8), making cubical result topologically natural under automorphisms.
